metadata.description: Curated Claude Code plugins for browser E2E testing, plugin quality, production monitoring, and developer workflows

plugins.name: e2e-pipeline
plugins.description: Browser & CLI E2E testing pipeline with context-isolating subagents — map UI, generate flows, verify & test, walk through apps, record video, terminal recording for CLI-only flows, static UI computed-style verification

plugins.name: kc-plugin-forge
plugins.description: One-command plugin development and quality pipeline — scaffold, TDD skills, verify agents, validate structure, audit frontmatter, optimize descriptions, doc self-iteration, two-stage Dreaming (LOCAL→public sanitize gate + public→structured taxonomy gate), prepublish sanitize-check

plugins.name: kc-nightwatch
plugins.description: Autonomous nightly improvement — forge validation, multi-source signal discovery (journal, Sentry, E2E, git), north-star-aligned proposals and alerts

plugins.name: kc-hyperfocus
plugins.description: Session lifecycle & context efficiency — context pressure detection, cleanup enforcement, cross-session handoff/resume, MCP context firewall, context lake cache, journal with vector search, and statusline with usage quota

plugins.name: kc-team-ops
plugins.description: Team operations pipeline — EM triage with strategic lens (depth-adaptive routing, team context cache), project pulse updates, codebase exploration, issue decomposition, and structured Linear management

plugins.name: kc-pr-flow
plugins.description: PR lifecycle workflow — create (ship chain), review (incl. Trail of Bits security subagents + 5 pr-review-toolkit agents covering correctness/comments/silent-failure/type-design/test-coverage, optional Codex cross-model second opinion, cross-file doc-claim verification, per-agent 1-10 confidence calibration), resolve review threads with cross-review verdict persistence (suppress prior-dismissed findings across review cycles), commit reorg, announce, and automated daemon
